source.title: Bioelectric signaling regulates head and organ size during planarian regeneration.
source.location: Results text ('RNA interference (RNAi) of the Smed-H,K-ATPase' paragraph) and Fig. 2A legend

stage: trunk fragment (pharynx fragment retaining the original pharynx)
injury: two transverse amputations, just anterior and just posterior to the pharynx

intervention.timing: dsRNA injected on days 1-3; worms cut on day 8 or day 14
intervention.description: Worms were injected with dsRNA targeting Smed-H,K-ATPase, then cut into pharynx fragments and left to regenerate.

readout.method: brightfield scoring of head and pharynx size and position

notes: Percentages only; n given as a lower bound (n>=125) so n_total is null. 'other' is the paper's 'shrunken head' class: regenerates with proportionally very tiny heads and large, anteriorly shifted pharynges. The two stated percentages do not sum to 100 and the remaining ~4.2% of regenerates is not described, so no normal count is recorded. A and B both read these two values; B's intervention.type (ion_channel_misexpression) was a validator workaround and is corrected to ion_channel_knockdown. lab is the last author (Levin) per the manifest.

adjudication.note: same numbers in A and B; B's RNAi row was mis-typed as ion_channel_misexpression, corrected to ion_channel_knockdown
